description: The "where every part is built" tables of the master blueprint (sections 64.11 onward), one row per line of each table. A row names its build sections; "done" maps a section to the version that finished that row's part there, "progress" lists what is already in place while the section is being built, and "nothing" marks a line with no part. A build section is not locked until every row naming it is done there (tests/test_build_tables.py). Change a row only by the blueprint.
